subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of his/her uniqueness: name, gender and physical body parts and their functions.
indicatorText: Talk about who they are (name, gender, age and date of birth)
exemplarText: Name the days of the week and months of the year (birthday)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of his/her uniqueness: name, gender and physical body parts and their functions.
indicatorText: Identify the parts of the body and their functions
exemplarText: Sing songs/recite rhymes about the parts of the body.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of his/her uniqueness: name, gender and physical body parts and their functions.
indicatorText: Recognize and talk about the different parts of a book (front/cover page and back of a book) and relate the content of the text to our body parts.
exemplarText: Show the front and back covers of a big book. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the book.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of his/her uniqueness: name, gender and physical body parts and their functions.
indicatorText: Demonstrate appropriate use of the body parts
exemplarText: 1. Sing songs and recite rhymes involving action and movement of the body parts (e.g. I am jumping, I am clapping etc.) 2. Engage in physical activities such as walking on a straight line, hopping, skipping etc. 3. Carry out actions that demonstrate hand-eye coordination (e.g. threading, picking and grasping objects).

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of his/her uniqueness: name, gender and physical body parts and their functions.
indicatorText: Demonstrate understanding of basic personal hygiene (caring for the body)
exemplarText: 1. Talk about how to care for the body (e.g. bathing, brushing teeth and hair, washing hands and clothes). 2. Sing songs and recite rhymes about personal hygiene.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the types and members of the family.
indicatorText: Identify the types of family (Nuclear and Extended)
exemplarText: Talk about the family type they belong to.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the types and members of the family.
indicatorText: Identify the members of the family
exemplarText: 1. Mention the names of family members (e.g. mother, father, siblings, grandparents, aunties, uncles etc.) 2. Draw and colour family members.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the types and members of the family.
indicatorText: Identify the roles of the members of the family.
exemplarText: Role-play duties of family members (e.g. cooking, sweeping, fetching water etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the types and members of the family.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on family and relate it to their own family
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on the family and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the types and members of the family.
indicatorText: Demonstrate love and respect for members of the family
exemplarText: 1. Sing songs and recite rhymes on love and respect for family members. 2. Use courtesy words (e.g. please, thank you, sorry, may I etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the home as a place for shelter/protection and a place for belonging.
indicatorText: Identify the parts of the home (e.g. rooms, compound, gate etc.)
exemplarText: Identify the parts of a home from a big book/pictures.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the home as a place for shelter/protection and a place for belonging.
indicatorText: Describe the activities that take place in the home
exemplarText: Role-play activities that take place in the home (e.g. cooking, sweeping, bathing etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the home as a place for shelter/protection and a place for belonging.
indicatorText: Interact with books on my home and relate it to their own homes
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on the home and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the home as a place for shelter/protection and a place for belonging.
indicatorText: Demonstrate understanding of safety in the home
exemplarText: 1. Identify dangerous objects in the home and discuss how to avoid accidents (e.g. sharp objects, fire, electricity etc.) 2. Role play safety measures in the home.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the school as a place for learning and making friends.
indicatorText: Identify the physical features of the school
exemplarText: Take a walk around the school compound and identify the physical features (e.g. classrooms, office, canteen/kitchen, toilet/urinal, playground etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the school as a place for learning and making friends.
indicatorText: Identify the members of the school community
exemplarText: Mention the names of the head teacher, teachers, friends, school prefects etc.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the school as a place for learning and making friends.
indicatorText: Describe the activities that take place in the school
exemplarText: Role-play activities in the school (e.g. learning, playing, eating, singing etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the school as a place for learning and making friends.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on school and relate it to their school
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on the school and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of the school as a place for learning and making friends.
indicatorText: Demonstrate understanding of safety in the school
exemplarText: 1. Identify dangerous areas/objects in the school and discuss how to avoid accidents. 2. Role play safety measures in the school.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of living and non-living things
indicatorText: Identify living and non-living things in the environment
exemplarText: 1. Go on a nature walk and identify living things (plants and animals) and non-living things (stones, sand, water etc.) 2. Sort objects into living and non-living things.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of living and non-living things
indicatorText: Differentiate between living and non-living things
exemplarText: Talk about the characteristics of living things (e.g. move, grow, eat, breath, reproduce) and non-living things (do not move, do not grow, do not eat, do not breath, do not reproduce)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of living and non-living things
indicatorText: Interact with texts on living and non-living things
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on living and non-living things and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of parts of plants and their uses.
indicatorText: Identify parts of a plant
exemplarText: Observe a plant and identify the parts (e.g. roots, stem, leaves, flowers, fruits)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of parts of plants and their uses.
indicatorText: Identify uses of plants
exemplarText: Talk about the uses of plants (e.g. food, medicine, shade, decoration etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of parts of plants and their uses.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on plants
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on plants and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of parts of plants and their uses.
indicatorText: Care for plants
exemplarText: 1. Weed around plants. 2. Water plants. 3. Avoid destroying plants.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of domestic and wild animals.
indicatorText: Identify domestic and wild animals
exemplarText: 1. Name domestic animals (e.g. cat, dog, goat, sheep, hen etc.) 2. Name wild animals (e.g. lion, elephant, snake, tiger, monkey etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of domestic and wild animals.
indicatorText: Imitate sounds and movements of animals
exemplarText: 1. Make sounds of animals (e.g. miaow, woof, baa, moo etc.) 2. Move like animals (e.g. jump like a frog, fly like a bird, crawl like a snake etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of domestic and wild animals.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on animals
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on animals and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of domestic and wild animals.
indicatorText: Show kindness to animals
exemplarText: 1. Feed animals. 2. Give water to animals. 3. Do not throw stones at animals.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of sources and uses of water.
indicatorText: Identify sources of water
exemplarText: Mention sources of water (e.g. tap, rain, river, well, borehole etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of sources and uses of water.
indicatorText: Identify uses of water
exemplarText: Talk about uses of water (e.g. drinking, bathing, washing, cooking, watering plants etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of sources and uses of water.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on water
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on water and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of sources and uses of water.
indicatorText: Demonstrate proper use and storage of water
exemplarText: 1. Close tap after use. 2. Do not waste water. 3. Cover water containers.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of air and its uses.
indicatorText: Demonstrate the presence of air
exemplarText: 1. Blow air into a balloon. 2. Feel air blown from the mouth/fan/paper fan on the body.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of air and its uses.
indicatorText: Identify uses of air
exemplarText: Talk about uses of air (e.g. breathing, drying clothes, flying kites, inflating tyres/balloons etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of air and its uses.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on air
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on air and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of air and its uses.
indicatorText: Demonstrate ways of keeping the air clean
exemplarText: 1. Avoid burning rubbish. 2. Cover nose when sneezing/coughing. 3. Dust furniture/sweep compound to remove dust.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of God as the creator.
indicatorText: Identify things created by God
exemplarText: Mention things created by God (e.g. humans, animals, plants, sun, moon, stars, water etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of God as the creator.
indicatorText: Recognise that God provides for us
exemplarText: Talk about things God provides (e.g. food, water, air, parents, shelter etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of God as the creator.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on God's creation
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on creation and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of God as the creator.
indicatorText: Express appreciation to God for His creation
exemplarText: 1. Sing songs of praise/thanksgiving. 2. Say simple prayers to thank God.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of good values/morals.
indicatorText: Identify good values/morals
exemplarText: Mention good values (e.g. honesty, respect, obedience, sharing, kindness etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of good values/morals.
indicatorText: Demonstrate good values in daily activities
exemplarText: Role-play situations showing honesty, sharing, respect etc.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of good values/morals.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on values
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on values and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of national celebrations.
indicatorText: Identify national celebrations
exemplarText: Mention national celebrations (e.g. Independence Day, Farmers' Day, Republic Day etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of national celebrations.
indicatorText: Describe how national celebrations are observed
exemplarText: Talk about activities during celebrations (e.g. marching, singing national anthem, wearing traditional clothes, holidays etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of national celebrations.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on national celebrations
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on celebrations and answer simple questions.

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of means of communication and transportation.
indicatorText: Identify means of communication
exemplarText: Mention means of communication (e.g. talking, telephone, television, radio, drum etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of means of communication and transportation.
indicatorText: Identify means of transportation
exemplarText: Mention means of transportation (e.g. car, bus, bicycle, aeroplane, boat etc.)

subjectName: KG1 Our World and Our People
contentStandardText: Demonstrate understanding of means of communication and transportation.
indicatorText: Interact with texts on communication and transportation
exemplarText: 1. Do a picture walk and talk about the pictures in the big book. 2. Listen to a read aloud text on communication/transportation and answer simple questions.
